name: Flashcard maker
why: Quick one-question, one-answer cards from pasted notes, a lighter start before the full deck builder.

name: Recall quiz writer
why: A low-stakes recall quiz at three levels from lesson notes, the self-test habit this kit builds into every session.

name: Choose a study plan you can keep
why: Turns a goal, a date and weekly hours into a study roadmap with recall checks, like the revision timetable.

name: Get a stuck learner moving again
why: Diagnosis, one-step hints and a task ladder for a learner who is stuck, matching the hint ladder prompt.

name: Build a practice plan from common mistakes
why: Maps a learner's wrong answers and builds practice on the top mistakes after a practice exam.

name: Build a lesson from explanation to practice and a quiz
why: For tutors planning a full lesson: explanation, worked example, practice and a quiz in the order this kit uses.

name: Turn a worked example into independent practice
why: Moves a learner from a worked example to solving alone, the step after the hint ladder.

name: Study plan progress review assistant
why: Reviews progress against a study plan and adjusts practice, like the weekly check-in in the exam countdown.

name: Write a thinking task English learners can do
why: Adds a thinking task at the right language level, useful alongside the language practice set.

name: Small working example explainer
why: Finds the smallest example that shows how something works, for topics learners find abstract.
